location: Dante Alighieri Society of Massachusetts, 41 Hampshire St, Cambridge, MA 02139, USA
description: Dante's inferno happens on the 1st and 3rd Friday of each month. The event starts with a lesson at 9pm, followed by social dancing from 10pm-1am. On the 1st Friday, the lesson is a bachata lesson. On the 3rd Friday, the lesson is casino, given by the Boston Casineros. The social dancing that follows is typically salsa/bachata (not Cuban), but on the 3rd Fridays, it may include a few Cuban timba songs, especially if many Cuban dancers show up. name: Bachata Dance Workout @Morse Library
location: Lebowitz Meeting Hall, Morse Library, 14 E Central St, Natick, MA 01760, USA
description:
REGISTRATION REQUIRED AT MORSE LIBRARY WEBSITE
https://morseinstitute.assabetinteractive.com/calendar/for-adults-bachata-dance-workout-2/
Get ready to move to the infectious rhythms of Bachata, a dance from the Dominican Republic! This class is all about having fun and moving your body. The class will focus on high-energy follow-alongs that get your heart pumping with bachata footwork. If there is interest towards the end of the class,  we'll learn some fundamental partner work moves and get to connect with classmates.
The focus is on joy, not perfection! Liz's goal is for you to feel energized, move your body, and get a taste of social dancing.
This class is designed for EVERYBODY and EVERY BODY. We enthusiastically welcome students of all abilities, and can provide physical modifications and adaptations to ensure everyone can fully participate and enjoy the movement. No prior dance experiences is needed, and you do not need to bring a partner.
